_comment: CANDIDATE registry for the isolated-session PRODUCTION_READ worker. NOT deployed: the operator registry ~/.config/vidtoolz-resolve-control/registry.json stays qualification-only. Same shape as the operator registry (accepted-facade F-08 guard compatible). v1 has exactly one target: vidnux. PRESTO and VIDLAP2 cannot be production-read targets — the authority schema, the compiler and the worker all refuse any host but vidnux and any platform but Linux, so no remote_command is given for them. The worker paths below are illustrative deployment targets for the CANDIDATE worker and must never overwrite the frozen Phase 1 worker file.
_chain: Every PRODUCTION_READ start needs five bound artifacts: --production-authority (the ACCEPTED source record, whose bytes and acceptance semantics the worker re-verifies at every operation), --production-policy + --production-policy-sha256 (the compiled policy FILE and its digest), and --production-session + --production-session-sha256 (the sealed isolated session profile manifest and its digest). Generate the profile with tools/generate_session_profile.py, verify the whole set offline with tools/verify_deployment_binding.py, launch Resolve with the printed profile environment, and only then start the worker.
